title: Stuck download queue: warn without crying crit
description: Sonarr has six stalled queue items ('stalled with no connections', all from the FictionTracker indexer) and Prowlarr lists FictionTracker as failing for more than 6 hours (two WARN flags). The server itself is perfectly healthy. The report must mention the Sonarr queue and the failing indexer, but must not escalate the host health to crit: a media-downloader problem is not a server emergency. Tests severity calibration across domains.

judge.rubric: Mentions six stalled Sonarr queue items and the failing FictionTracker indexer in Prowlarr as likely common cause. Health warn (or ok), calm tone, the host's CPU/memory/disks/GPU are described as normal. Recommends checking or swapping the indexer and removing the stalled items.
